proposedDefects.brief: DE gearbox ratio attribute is inconsistent with the UK generator rated speed
proposedDefects.data: extended.drivetrainChain: rotor 12.1 rpm (ES-3701) x gearbox ratio 1:79 (D-37073, the digits of 1:97 transposed) = 955.9 rpm against 1173.7 rpm on UK-3701; the tooth counts of the gear parts give 97.02
proposedDefects.needs: a numeric attribute per assembly in the DE PLM (teil.attribut or a typed column) and the UK part table mapped to atelier:ratedSpeed, plus a product-level SHACL-SPARQL shape multiplying rotor speed by ratio and comparing with the generator speed within 1 %

proposedDefects.brief: UK torque values are in lbf-ft while the layer expects kN·m
proposedDefects.data: UK-3702 extended.ratedTorque 30004 lbf-ft (40.7 kN·m); the expressible analogue today is the unit defect on IF-102
proposedDefects.needs: a torque quantity on parts (value plus QUDT unit) and unit:LBF-FT in ontology/units.ttl, so the unit rule applies to torque as it does to positions

proposedDefects.brief: a tower bolt kit exists in ES at revision 2 while the offshore variant still references revision 1

proposedDefects.needs: revision and lifecycle columns on the PLM part tables, variant-scoped BOM lines with an expected revision, and a shape failing when the expected revision is not the current one

proposedDefects.brief: one FR blade part references a DE URN with the wrong site code
proposedDefects.needs: an external-reference table per PLM (reference_externe, externer_verweis, referencia_externa, external_ref) in the link graph and a resolver shape failing when the URN's site segment holds no part of that local id

proposedDefects.notExpressibleBecause: needs a same-site dependency relation the model does not carry: the software runs on the controller cabinet, a dependency between two items of the UK site; an external reference links two sites and the site's bill of materials does not hold this relation, so lifecycleConflict cannot report it
proposedDefects.brief: the controller software package is RELEASED, but its target hardware part is still Draft
